name: zeffect_anim_find_or_create_sound_ref
description: zEffectAnim::FindOrCreateSoundRef resolves an existing sound ref or creates and appends a runtime sound ref.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffectAnim runtime-ref/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x45e380 validates existing-ref lookup, gwSoundNew allocation, name/sample-set binding, list allocation growth, count update, and new index return.

The native smoke verifies creating the first nonzero sound ref, preserving the zero sentinel slot, binding the runtime node name/sample set, incrementing the count, and returning the existing index on repeat lookup.
